high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals sitting on a small boat on a sandy beach. The setting appears to be a coastal area with a vast expanse of sand stretching into the distance. In the background, there are a few people walking along the beach, and some structures that resemble small huts or stalls can be seen further back. The person on the left is wearing a purple sports uniform with "DREAM" written across the chest. They have a beard and are wearing bright yellow-green sneakers. The person on the right is dressed in an orange and black sports uniform with "KU" and "Jio" logos visible.
